implemented.nativeStorage: Retained leases reserve declared pixel bytes before GL handle creation and native storage submission. RGBA8/SRGB8 textures are 4 bytes per texel, RGBA32F textures 16, four-sample RGBA8 color storage 16; geometry buffers use exact submitted byteLength. Explicit destruction releases leases through native texture/buffer/renderbuffer deletion, including outside the active scope. Swaps preserve ownership because it follows native handles. Existing finite pools retain their actual storage until eviction/disposal.
implemented.readbacks: Native full/region/float GPU reads and row scratch are pre-admitted. Row and copied region temporaries release after use. The full incremental readback stays retained across frames, old full reads release on replacement, returned captures remain scratch through their caller boundary, and disposal detaches the retained backing. CPU uploads release after original native submission; PNG coordinate tables remain retained across scratch and release on replacement/disposal.
implemented.depth: The original pinned mesh/shader/math/attributes are retained. CPU software/hardware mesh data and actual GL vertex/index copies are independently admitted. Partial CPU/native initialization cleans its ownership. Immutable source/depth textures evict before admitting new storage; resized MSAA deletes old native color storage. Existing output/resolve textures follow device ownership.
implemented.scope: This checkpoint covers Canvas/GPU renderer-owned storage and native transfer lifetimes under opt-in allocator scopes. Audit assets/oracle pixels are loaded outside that scope. Native driver/private allocations, codec internals and physical RSS are separate from declared application storage. Small GL query/control results and the complete metadata category remain pending. The actual production export allocator is still disabled until assets/fonts, capture/upload, Node and metadata integration are complete. Per-page peaks are not a simultaneous aggregate measurement.
